name: HospitalSetting
description: Stores configurable settings for the hospital, such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

attributes.name: settingKey
attributes.description: A unique key identifying the hospital setting.

attributes.name: settingValue
attributes.description: The value associated with the setting key.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A brief description of what the setting controls.

attributes.name: dataType
attributes.description: The expected data type of the settingValue.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: A category for grouping related settings (e.g., 'general', 'appointments', 'security').
